topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe it, you're really going? It feels like just yesterday we were making all those promises about how nothing would ever change. This place won't be the same without you, every corner will just remind me of us, of all the times we swore we’d stick around. I don’t know how to do this, not without you here. But hey, we’ll figure it out, right? We’ll still laugh about the dumbest things over the phone, and I’ll make sure to send you all the weird stuff we see here, like we always planned. Just promise me we’ll keep this bond strong, no matter how many miles are between us. You’re not just a friend, you’re family, and nothing can change that.
